name: ParametricDates
description: Defines rules for the dates on which the price will be determined.

businessCenters.description: The enumerated values to specify the business centers.

dayDistribution.description: Denotes the method by which the pricing days are distributed across the pricing period.

dayFrequency.description: Defines the occurrence of the dayOfWeek within the pricing period on which pricing will take place, e.g. the 3rd Friday within each Calculation Period. If omitted, every dayOfWeek will be a pricing day.

dayOfWeek.description: Indicates the days of the week on which the price will be determined.

dayType.description: Denotes the enumerated values to specify the day type classification used in counting the number of days between two dates.

lag.description: The pricing period per calculation period if the pricing days do not wholly fall within the respective calculation period.
